code_quality_notes: TopPostEmbed.tsx:35 uses useMemo to dispatch a side-effect (setIndex on isError). This is a misuse — should be useEffect. Functionally works because the memo body runs once per (isError, index) tuple, but it is fragile and would trip strict mode. Non-blocking nit; flag for follow-up.
useStreakTracker re-arms via setRenderNonce on AppState change — works but could be simplified by listing AppState.currentState in the effect deps via a state mirror. Functional and tested.

WeeklyRecapCard wraps the constant RECAP_ZERO_POSTS_COPY in _(msg`${RECAP_ZERO_POSTS_COPY}`) — Lingui will treat the entire interpolation as a single non-extractable string. The test passes because the constant is rendered verbatim, but i18n extraction will not pick this string up. Recommend extracting to a top-level msg or using a static msg literal. Non-blocking — string IS rendered correctly today.
